fields.live: live points counted from the collection (must equal the plan ledger)
fields.live_sha256: SHA-256 of sorted little-endian u32 live ids (must equal the plan)
fields.writes_seconds: inserts + deletes of the batch (D includes its synchronous drains)
fields.settle_seconds: S only: time until optimizers idle (Green, status Ok) after the writes
fields.segments: [{uuid, appendable, live, deleted, learned_buckets}] after settling
fields.levels: D only: learned levels {level, live, buckets, router fingerprint}
fields.publications: D only: DLI publication events of this batch

batch_XX/rows.jsonl.policy: D: 'mdn_code' (budget = global candidate budget); S: 'static_nprobe' (budget = nprobe per segment)

per_run_files.batch_XX/topology.json: segments (S) or members (D) of the replayed snapshot
per_run_files.native-events.jsonl: every native optimizer job of both arms (QDRANT_OPTIMIZATION_EVENTS): sources, source_live_points, destination_points, job_wall_micros, native_phases
per_run_files.build-events.jsonl: every LMI build (QDRANT_LMI_BUILD_EVENTS): n_buckets, sample_count, teacher_mlp_seconds, reused_router, router_fingerprint, routing_postings_seconds
per_run_files.summary.json: system, arm, model, static_model, publications (D), seconds, source_head

fields.load: fixed target: qps_target, inflight_cap, timeout_ms, write_rate_points_s, chunk
fields.window: writer start -> maintenance settled: seconds, writes_seconds, settle_seconds, issued, ok, timeouts, errors, dropped_at_cap, achieved_qps, latency_ms {n,p50,p95,p99,max,mean}, deleted_point_violations, maintenance_busy_seconds, dli_max_backlog
fields.settled: one sequential pass of the panel after settling: latency_ms, recall30 against the batch gold
fields.dli_learned_fallback_before_after: D: (learned_queries, exact_fallbacks) counters before and after the batch
fields.counters_before/after: utime/stime ticks (CLK_TCK 100), rss/hwm KiB, read/write bytes (/proc/self/io), cgroup memory.current/peak

derived.W_X(t): work (mean scored_total) at mean test R@30 = 0.90 by linear interpolation in mean-work order; null if not attained
derived.R_w: mean_t W_D(t) / mean_t W_S(t) over batches 1-20 attained by both arms
derived.A_write_logical: sum destination_points of optimizer jobs after the initial load / points inserted after the initial load

not_yet_collected: router/selection/scoring time split for S in the replay
